verdict.rationale: Missive is a SaaS inbox with built-in AI features, so a buyer can fairly ask whether their data is kept out of model training. The evidence pack has no documented training opt-out or no-training commitment. The bring-your-own-API-key note (Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini) is an adjacent control, not a stated guarantee that data won't be used for training, so it earns no credit.
